name: PT Pabrik Kertas Tjiwi Kimia Tbk
summary: PT Pabrik Kertas Tjiwi Kimia Tbk manufactures and sells writing and printing paper products in Asia, Africa, Europe, the Middle East, the United States, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Cultural Paper Products, and Industrial Paper Products and Other.
